summary: Iteration 143: full test of plan gating / upgrade pop-up, landing + in-app plan cards ('Everything in X, plus:'), new email system (prefs, previews x14 types x3 langs, engine scanner, test/rate-limit, unsubscribe), readability scan, sidebar crash crawl, ESLint and the node email harness. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (after fixing 2 test-script issues on my side), node harness 38/38, ESLint 0 errors (15 warnings). Frontend: all core flows work; found 1 mobile header overflow on FR/ES landing, 1 upgrade-dialog loading race, untranslated 'Starter includes:' on FR/ES, Text calls page hides Pro numbers instead of showing them locked, and a stale legend on the Buy page.

minor.issue: FR money format is US style: subject '$50.00 sont arrivés sur votre portefeuille CloudIVR', body 'sous $10.00'. French readers expect '50,00 $'. Cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: Sign-up CTA [civr-nav-signup-btn] runs past the right edge of the screen and gets cut off: FR right edge is 446px, ES is 423px, on a 390px screen. The page doesn't scroll sideways (scrollWidth is 390) because the header clips it, so the button shows only as 'Dém…' / 'Inic…'. EN fits.

useCandidates() fetches /numbers each time the dialog opens. Until that returns, nums=[], so the main button reads 'Buy a Business number' and go() sends the user to /app/buy?plan=business instead of the number's billing tab. I saw this text right after opening the dialog. A fast click goes to the wrong page. Fix: use the numbers from the shell/cache, or disable the button while loading.

The caller list only holds Business numbers (useCallerNumbers('textRelay')), so the Pro and Starter numbers don't appear at all, with no lock pill or upgrade pop-up. A Locked card appears only when the account has no Business number. This doesn't follow the request to keep locked features visible with a pop-up.
Starter heading stays English ('Starter includes:') in FR and ES. Pro and Business are translated ('Tout dans Starter, plus :' / 'Todo en Starter, más:').

integration_issues.issue: Entering 0 or 5000 never reaches the API. The input's own min=1/max=1000 check blocks the form, so the user sees the browser tooltip ('Value must be ≥ 1') and not the error toast 'Pick an alert amount between $1 and $1,000.'. The value 5000 also stays in the box. The API itself correctly returns 400 with that message.

issues: The eyebrow pill text 'Numéros virtuels · SVI entrant & sortant · Agents vocaux IA' wraps to 2 lines inside a 1-line rounded pill, so the text overlaps the pill's border
The legend '✓ included · ✗ not on that plan' is out of date: the cards now list only what each plan adds, and no ✗ items are ever shown
All card text (labels, toasts, example names) is hard-coded English, unlike the rest of the app's i18n

action_items: Fix the FR/ES mobile landing header overflow: shorten the CTA label or hide the login text below about 400px
Upgrade dialog: don't show the 'Buy a <plan> number' fallback or allow navigation while /numbers is still loading
Text calls page: list Pro/Starter numbers with a lock that opens showUpgrade({feature:'Text calls', need:'business', phone})
EmailPrefs low-balance: drop the native min/max (or add noValidate) so the API error toast shows, or show your own inline error
Remove or replace the '✗ not on that plan' legend on the Buy page
Optional: localise money format in FR/ES emails; i18n for the Email notifications card
critical_code_review_comments: Upgrade.js: the dialog's /numbers request runs on every open. Reuse shell data to avoid the label/route race.

emails.js walletLevels runs only every 5th tick (about 5 min), so walletEmpty/lowBalance can take up to about 5 min. Confirmed: walletEmpty (fr) arrived after about 5 min for the new QA account. That's fine, just worth documenting.
Test emails are recorded even when the group is switched off (by design, and the harness checks it).

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core flows pass; 2 medium + 3 low UI issues)

seed_data_creation: Registered qa.mail7135863@example.com / QaTest#2026x (lang fr). Bought dry-run number +13525312446 for it via crypto checkout + simulate-payment, then released it. Alice was left unchanged: 3 numbers, all email switches ON, lowBalanceAt 10, no presets, scheduled preview call cancelled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified working: landing pricing headings and feature lists (EN desktop/mobile, FR/ES no crash); Buy page plan cards; Pro number (+13313039077): IVR tab usable, locks on triggers and ai tabs, Text Triggers locked card opens the upgrade dialog with title, price and 'Business also gives you'; Not now, Esc and backdrop all close it; go button routes to ?tab=billing&plan=business. Starter number: 8 tab locks pointing to Pro. Business number: no locks. Quick IVR: Pro shows schedule and preset locks that open the pop-up, Business shows the date picker and preset input. Backend gates: schedule/preset/relay/text-triggers 403 from Pro, 200/201 from Business; prefs/voice PUT 200. Email: prefs GET/PUT with validation, 14 types x en/fr/es render with no undefined/NaN, 404 for unknown type, 401 when logged out, unsubscribe GET/POST/tampered works, engine sends welcome (en), then topup, numberLive and walletEmpty in fr with no duplicates, test email limited to 10 per hour (11th returns 429). Sidebar crawl: no crash screens. Cmd/K palette and inbox OK. Low-contrast scan of dashboard/numbers/settings/wallet found nothing below 4:1. The correct text call route is /app/text-call (not text-calls). A preview login glob '**/app**' matches the host name 'app-vault'; use '**/cloudivr/app**'.
